content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The implementation of retirement at 63 is no longer socially sustainable, as the population in Germany has, viewed demographically, a disproportionate number of old people, and constantly declining birth rates are being recorded. Admittedly the number of immigrants is constantly rising in Germany, but without sufficient, well-qualified junior employees there is hardly a possibility for adequate pension financing.
What is the relation between "but without sufficient, well-qualified junior employees there is hardly a possibility for adequate pension financing." and "Admittedly the number of immigrants is constantly rising in Germany," from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
